story: Sara makes a shopping list. She looks in the fridge and sees a potato. She hates the dark, so she takes an umbrella. She meets Ivan by the park later.
title: A Shopping Trip
setting: A kitchen and a street near a park.

characters.name: Sara
characters.look: a young woman with long brown hair and a blue coat

characters.name: Ivan
characters.look: a tall man with short black hair and a green jacket

characters.name: Maya
characters.look: a small girl with blonde pigtails

sentences.en: Sara writes a long list for food.
sentences.zh: 莎拉写了一份很长的食物清单。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara, a young woman with long brown hair and a blue coat, writes a list on paper in a kitchen.

sentences.en: She looks inside my big fridge.
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara looks inside a large white fridge in a bright kitchen.

sentences.en: She can see one brown potato.
sentences.zh: 她能看见一个棕色的土豆。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara sees a single brown potato on a shelf inside the fridge.

sentences.en: She hates the dark night sky.
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara looks at a dark window with a worried face.

sentences.en: She takes an umbrella from the hall.
sentences.zh: 她从走廊拿了一把雨伞。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara takes a black umbrella from a stand in a hallway.

sentences.en: She puts on her warm coat.
sentences.zh: 她穿上了她温暖的外套。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara puts on a blue coat near the door.

sentences.en: She meets Ivan by the park.
sentences.zh: 她在公园旁边遇见了伊万。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara meets Ivan, a tall man with short black hair, by a park gate.

sentences.en: They meet again later after dinner.
sentences.zh: 他们在晚餐后稍后再次见面。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara and Ivan meet again on a street after a meal.
